effect.justification: The injected reliability margin is chosen so that the protocol can assess whether three blind coders can reach alpha >= 0.80 while retaining within-regime discrimination.

noise_estimation.description: Independent coder errors are generated at transition level; no fold or cell is treated as an independent experiment.

test_definition: Simulate six ordinal dimensions for three blind coders, recompute ordinal Krippendorff alpha and require within-regime discrimination for every retained dimension.
